description.en: Animates a camera's depth-of-field "DepthRange" parameter (see CMND_SET_CAMERA_PARAM) from one value to another over a number of frames.
True once the call has taken effect; null if the call was invalid (e.g. too few arguments, or required engine/script state not ready).

example.code:
// Animate the camera's depth-of-field range
CMND_DEPTHRANGE_FADE(hCam, 1.0, 1.5, _frame);
